scenarios.title: Pune bakery: a pivot beats a thin-margin original
scenarios.summary: ₹10,000, about 3 cakes a day, weekends only. Everyday cakes barely pay; custom celebration cakes score higher.

scenarios.title: Pune bakery: keep your original idea
scenarios.summary: ₹10,000, weekends only. The original cakes have a healthy margin and the alternative needs equipment you lack.

scenarios.title: Pune bakery: nothing is viable yet
scenarios.summary: ₹5,000 is too little. The original has no margin and the alternative is over budget, so nothing is recommended.

scenarios.title: Noida: feasibility only, no market data
scenarios.summary: A high-protein breakfast box outside Pune. The numbers are checked, but there is no market data, so no pivots are suggested.
